spans.s: snigdhaka, adj. (cf. Pali ati-siniddhaka, acc. pl. ˚ke, very loving friends, Mahāvaṃsa 〔36.44〕, acc. to PTS ed., where Turnour read -sinehake, which is quoted by PTSD as well as Childers; cf. snehaka which replaces this word in Divy 〔38.24, 31〕; = Skt. snigdha; endearing dim. -ka?), affectionate, gentle, kind: (bhadrakā …) ˚kā vata Śroṇāparāntakā manuṣyā(ḥ) Divy 〔38.16〕 (prose).
Snigdhagātra, n. of a former Buddha: Mv 〔i.141.8〕.
